blurb: Guests use the range for shooting pistols, rifles, and shotguns up to .300 Win. Mag. caliber. Firearm rentals and ammunition sales are available. The range operates 7 days a week with walk-ins only, no membership required.

extraNote: Walk-ins only, no membership required · No black powder firearms or pepper ball guns allowed · Ammunition must be checked before entering; no armor piercing, tracer, incendiary, steel core, steel case, or green tip ammo · No birdshot, target, or trap loads for shotguns; only slug or buckshot allowed · No use of firearms under influence of drugs or alcohol · No food or beverages on the range · No open-toed shoes on the range · Members limited to 2 hours per session when at full capacity
